paragraphs.text: Unofficial DSH plugin: delegate independent tasks to the local Antigravity CLI (agy) via the officia
l OAR tool shape; non-ACP runtime, eight-language UI.
DSH plugin that delegates standalone tasks to the local Antigravity CLI (`agy`). It reuses the offic
ial OAR tool shape with a non-ACP AGY runtime; unofficial wrapper.
## What's new in 0.3.0
- Startup watchdog (default 60 s) and stall watchdog (default 15 min) end silent runs with one termi

nal notification.
- `subagent_oar_agy_control` adds `status` and `cancel` for AGY runs started by th

e current parent session.
- Bounded status snapshots: at most 50 runs, 20 activity entries, and 200-

character excerpts; no prompts, tool arguments, full answers, or raw stderr.
- AGY starts from the o
fficial scrubbed parent environment, local failure logs are redacted, and process-tree teardown is v
scrubbed parent environment, local failure logs are redacted, and process-tree teardown is verified.
# Languages
简体中文 · English · Deutsch · Español · Français · 日本語 · Português · Русский
# Install
Paste this into the DeepSeek Harness plugin manager install box (Settings → Plugins):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Fallback tarball: `https://github.com/jiezhengj/DSH-Subagent-OAR-AGY/releases/download/v0.3.0/subage
nt-oar-agy-0.3.0.tgz`
Then enable "AGY Subagent" and reload DSH when prompted (restart if needed). Requirements: DSH 0.2.2
-rc.1 or later (below 0.3.0), and Antigravity CLI (`agy`) installed and signed in on this machine.
# Migrating from a tgz install
A profile installed from a tgz cannot check for updates. Remove the old entry in Plugin Management (
or run `dsh plugin remove @jiezhengj/subagent-oar-agy`), then install by the name above; the plugin
configuration is normally retained; if it is removed with the old entry, re-enter your previous sett
ings. The version section should then show the current version and “Up to date”, so later upgrades c
an happen in the app.
